answer: The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Every claim climbs the atlas of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sonnet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
